caption: The video captures an open cardboard box resting on a patch of bare dirt edged by grass and scattered dry leaves, with a fire already burning inside it on a bed of twigs and leaf litter. Bright yellow-orange flames with reddish tips rise continuously from the box, flickering and reshaping from frame to frame so that no single flame silhouette holds steady. The flame column repeatedly leans toward the upper-right, shedding detached tongue-like tips that break off above the box rim. Flame height shifts throughout the excerpt, moving from bushier, lower spreads to taller, narrower plumes that stretch diagonally across the upper portion of the frame. A faint pale wisp of smoke drifts at the left flap edge, while the incandescent core at the base of the fire and the glowing fuel bed remain visible inside the box. The box, its open flaps, the dirt, and the surrounding grass stay fixed in place. The only motion in the scene is the restless, ongoing combustion of the fire.
relations: Burning twigs and leaf litter inside the box feed flames that flicker and reshape continuously from frame to frame.
As combustion sustains, the flame column leans toward the upper-right and sheds detached tongue-like tips above the box rim.
Flame height shifts between bushier lower spreads and taller narrower plumes while the incandescent core stays visible at the base.
The open cardboard box, dirt, and grass remain fixed, so only the fire and a faint smoke wisp show motion.
